T1.implementation_approach: Design a user-friendly interface using wireframes and mockups. Implement using frontend frameworks.
T1.notes: Focus on intuitive navigation and responsive design.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful APIs for problem repository operations like create, read, update, delete.

T3.implementation_approach: Design schema for storing problem details including metadata, constraints, and examples.
T3.notes: Optimize for query performance and scalability.

T4.implementation_approach: Create a UI for users to submit code with syntax highlighting and file upload options.
T4.notes: Include error handling and validation for code submissions.

T5.implementation_approach: Develop backend APIs to handle code submissions, store them, and trigger evaluation.
T5.notes: Integrate with the evaluation system for real-time feedback.

T6.implementation_approach: Design schema to store submitted code, user details, and submission status.
T6.notes: Ensure data integrity and support for concurrent submissions.

T7.implementation_approach: Develop a system to compile, execute, and evaluate code against test cases.
T7.notes: Use containerization for secure and isolated execution.

T8.implementation_approach: Design a UI for user profiles with sections for personal details, achievements, and activity.
T8.notes: Ensure responsive design and easy customization.

T9.implementation_approach: Develop backend APIs for managing user profile data including updates and retrieval.
T9.notes: Implement secure authentication and data validation.

T10.implementation_approach: Design schema to store user profile data including personal details and activity logs.
T10.notes: Ensure scalability and efficient indexing for frequent queries.

T11.implementation_approach: Design a UI to display leaderboard rankings with filters and sorting options.
T11.notes: Focus on real-time updates and visual appeal.

T12.implementation_approach: Develop backend APIs to fetch and update leaderboard data based on user performance.

T13.implementation_approach: Design schema to store leaderboard data including user scores and rankings.
T13.notes: Ensure efficient sorting and filtering capabilities.

T14.implementation_approach: Design a UI for hints and tutorials with search and categorization features.

T15.implementation_approach: Develop backend APIs to manage hints and tutorials including creation, retrieval, and updates.
T15.notes: Ensure proper categorization and search functionality.

T16.implementation_approach: Design schema to store hints and tutorials with metadata like tags and categories.
T16.notes: Optimize for search and retrieval performance.

T17.implementation_approach: Perform unit, integration, and end-to-end testing for frontend components.
T17.notes: Focus on UI responsiveness and functionality.

T18.implementation_approach: Perform unit and integration testing for backend APIs and services.
T18.notes: Ensure API reliability and performance under load.

T19.implementation_approach: Perform schema validation, data integrity checks, and query performance testing.
T19.notes: Focus on data consistency and scalability.

T20.implementation_approach: Deploy the platform using containerization and cloud services.

        """

        Args:
            id (int): Unique identifier for the problem.
            title (str): The title of the problem.
            description (str): A detailed description of the problem.
            difficulty (str): The difficulty level of the problem.
            tags (list, optional): A list of tags related to the problem. Defaults to None.

        self.title = title
        self.description = description
        self.difficulty = difficulty
        self.tags = tags or []

        Returns a string representation of the Problem instance.

from flask import Blueprint

# Aggregating all blueprints
def register_blueprints(app):
    from app.controllers.problem_controller import problem_bp
    from app.controllers.user_controller import user_bp
    from app.controllers.solution_controller import solution_bp

    app.register_blueprint(problem_bp)
    app.register_blueprint(user_bp)
    app.register_blueprint(solution_bp)

from flask import Flask
from app.database import db
from app.controllers.problem_controller import problem_bp
from app.controllers.user_controller import user_bp
from app.controllers.solution_controller import solution_bp

def create_app():
    app = Flask(__name__)

    # Configuration can be set here if needed
    app.config['SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI'] = 'sqlite:///app.db'
    app.config['SQLALCHEMY_TRACK_MODIFICATIONS'] = False

    # Initialize database
    db.init_app(app)

    # Register blueprints
    app.register_blueprint(problem_bp, url_prefix='/problems')
    app.register_blueprint(user_bp, url_prefix='/users')
    app.register_blueprint(solution_bp, url_prefix='/solutions')

    # Return the app instance
    return app

from app import create_app

app = create_app()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app.run(debug=True)

code_repository.readme_content:
# ACM Problem-Solving Platform

A website designed to help users solve ACM-style programming problems.

## Features

- Problem Repository: A comprehensive collection of ACM-style programming problems categorized by difficulty and topic.
- Code Submission and Evaluation: Allows users to submit code solutions and receive automated feedback on correctness and performance.
- User Profiles and Progress Tracking: Enables users to create profiles, track their progress, and view their problem-solving history.
- Leaderboard: Displays a ranking of users based on their problem-solving performance and achievements.
- Hints and Tutorials: Provides hints and tutorials to help users understand problem-solving techniques.

## Setup

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
python app.py
```

## Usage

Open http://localhost:5000 in your browser.
